claim_ceiling: Schema-validated user imports with warnings; Fractal map 7-resolution ladder (REPRODUCED) with legal coherence metrics exposed via API; Legal cited decisions representation (ACCEPTED, 14/14 benchmarks PASS, citation heritage AUC 0.9719) as selectable map mode. evidence_summary: All 93 product tests PASS. New schema_validator.py (350 lines) validates required fields, enums, dates, decision_id patterns, provenance; supports strict/lenient modes, batch validation, auto-normalization. CorpusLoader integrates validator with strict_validation flag and warnings output. MapLoader adds _load_fractal_map_7res() loading 7-resolution ladder (4→8→12→14→19→24→27 clusters) + hierarchical Leiden (98 clusters, nesting=1.0, purity=0.949) with 5 new API methods for cluster_metadata, zoom_mappings, decision_clusters, zoom_coherence. Adds _load_legal_cited_decisions() loading ACCEPTED signal (TF-IDF on cited_decisions only, 4615 vocab, 14/14 PASS, AUC 0.9719) with 4 zoom levels. New data: legal_signals_1000.jsonl, legal_cited_decisions/ (embeddings, projection, metadata), product_integration/ (cluster_metadata, zoom_mappings, decision_clusters, zoom_coherence, integration_summary). Frontend adds legal_cited_decisions to map modes. Test_legal_cited_decisions verifies representation, zoom levels, metadata, neighbors, map_modes. Known issues: requirements.txt missing sentence-transformers; zoom_coherence.json shows 0% improvement vs claimed 59.2%; legal_cited_decisions reuses baseline Leiden clustering instead of re-clustering on legal embeddings; build script has hardcoded absolute path.
